copy_gaps: Bar times 07:05-07:55 (the frame): the spec gives no times for a window wholly before the recording start; the board draws ten whole 5m columns 07:05-07:50 and, in the 18 px right of them, the 07:55 kline's candle strip (that kline closes at 08:00, the strip's timestamp), so the window ends about 07:55:45 and the recording-start boundary (board 32) is out of view.
No date on the time axis: the frame's bars are on 2026-10-18 while the clock reads 'UTC 13:39:19' (now); a day marker is E11-D02's time-axis format, not given by this spec; the strip names the date.

E12-D02's frame `SCR-030/partial-history-time` words the line '…; earlier bars come from exchange klines' (E12-D02 L272); the spec (L401) and `14`'s E12 matrix (L703) say '…; earlier bars from exchange klines': the board draws the spec's.

SCR-047 1a's cause sentence, `Learn more` and the live-data sentence are E11-D04 §11.2's (L342, L351), drawn by reference (§5 L401: 'nothing to draw: SCR-047 1a (E11-D04 D12's …)'); E16-D05 finalises the deck (E11-D04 L1014).

OQ-10 (L929): two non-owner sentences, E11-D04 D12's 'You can't start recording with your role — ask the owner to record BTCUSDT.' on SCR-047 1a (inset C) and `rbac.owner_only` 'Only the owner can start recording.' on the strip (inset B), both drawn until it closes.

The announcement of the never-recorded strip line (insets A, B): the spec and `14`'s matrix name none; the board treats it as the partial-history line (not announced; in the chart's accessible description).

§8.1 L722 lists `Record this symbol`, then `Dismiss`; §5 L401 gives this line none and `14` L709 ties `Dismiss` to transient outcome notices, so A and B draw none and the line stays while the state holds; route: §8.1 L722 → '(`Retry`, then `Dismiss`; or `Record this symbol`)'.

Strip length: reason 1a is 69 characters; with Record this symbol (A) 88, with the T2 sentence (B) 105, against E12-D02's 'about 80 characters' (L75). Both fit one 24 px row at 1280 × 800 compact; the strip's 200 % zoom reflow is not specified (E12-D02's row).
The legend's footprint row in a window with no cells: §4.9 L380-382 gives no variant, so it reads as at L0, 'FP Bid × Ask · rows 10 ticks · BTC' (the layer is on).

↑ / ↓ and Enter on a kline-only bar (the frame, A, B): §8.1 L731-732 move the level box and expand up to 40 level nodes, but such a bar has none: they find no levels (no cells) and expand nothing; the spec gives no announcement for that case (copy gap, E18-S11).
SCR-047's mirror label and the block's spacing are E11-D04's (L336); the block's 12 px gaps are the kit's.
Candles: bars.mjs with the bench CLI's default seed '20260928' (run-bench.mjs:41): §3 L171-173 names the generator but no seed (the kit's scene() gap, kept for the candles).
live_checks: Insets A, B and D: each 'body' (clip on) must clip its placed chart rows at the crop height (176 / 176 / 216 px); the pane's wicks run past it by design.
Every inset 'body': the inner hairline (color.border.default) must draw on the body's edge without moving its placed rows.
Frame: the 'bar 07:55' column (18 × 704 at plot x 1190, clip off) must show its wick at plot x 1198 and its body at x 1197-1200, inside the plot and left of the price gutter.

Insets C and D: the pane-stack region (a flex column, align and justify centre) must centre the SCR-047 block; the Learn more underline (1 px rect at the kit's estimated width) must match the rendered label width.
Inset B: the T2 sentence must sit on the strip's one row after reason 1a, in color.text.secondary, with no lock glyph and no control.
rename frame 'SCR-030∕fp-empty-history' to 'SCR-030/fp-empty-history' after the board's last section (Penpot shows 'SCR-030 / fp-empty-history')
root: after the first section the root must read back exactly as the sheet's board.name
deviations: Frame: the kit's candles, k.scene(11) (bars.mjs bars 0-10, seed '20260928', bar k = the k-th back from the newest; bars 0-9 are the base grid's, boards 01-06), relabelled 07:05-07:55, none forming: the ten whole columns 07:05-07:50 are bars 10-1 and the 18 px right of them hold bar 0's lane and candle strip (07:55; margin_column(): the kit's bar_column() at x 1190 cut to the visible 18 px; no time label, it would sit under the price gutter). Every bar spans the 40-row window (§3 L192-193's 400-tick bar), so each wick runs top to bottom; the kit's candles-only path (level 'L3', no marks; k.panel() uses it for fp='off' and 'pending') draws them, with [FP] on and the legend's footprint row kept.

Insets A and B are 1:1 crops of a 1280 × 800 compact chart: the toolbar, status row and strip, and the pane's top 104 px (the legend and the candles' tops); the live window 12:50-13:35 of every SCR-030 board. Price labels wholly below the crop are dropped (7 in A, 7 in B).
Inset D is a 1:1 crop of inset C's pane-stack region (1280 × 728) around the centred block, for the owner.

Every inset body has a hairline edge (k.LINE: color.border.default, border.hairline, inner, so nothing moves): the board root and the SCR-047 region share color.surface.canvas, and the edge shows each 1:1 crop's extent (board presentation, not a product edge).

The strip row (E12-D02's (S)) is on color.surface.raised (E12-D02 L75) in the frame and every inset: raise_strip() sets it, because the kit's strip_row() fills it with the paper (a kit-wide fix for its owner; board 03 does the same).

T2's sentence form (B; C's E11-D04 D12 sentence) draws no lock glyph and no control: E09-D09 §2.2 'the reason sentence stands alone, no button'; the standing gate's G-T2.1d 'the sentence form has no glyph and no button'; the sentence in the reason grey (color.text.secondary).
SCR-047's live-data glyph (color.data-confidence.live.indicator, E11-D04 L624) is a hue token: not drawn (greyscale); the words carry it (E11-D04 §11.3).
The Learn more link is underlined with a 1 px ink rule (cvsheet v1 texts have no underline; E11-D04 §11.1: the underline says 'link').

Local helpers in gen_31.py (e18kit.py not edited): pin_docs(), the LOCAL copy deck, crop(), margin_column(), raise_strip(), strip_sentence_form(), strip_record(), scr047_block(), scr047_chassis(), link(), inset_box(), key_groups(), strip_lengths(), prune_log(), the .md writer.
The Learn more link is drawn in ink: E11-D04's color.text.link (L619) is not one of the board's greys; the underline carries 'link'.
